title: Upgrade Podman to latest version on Ubuntu 26.04
body:
### Feature request description

Currently, in ubuntu 26.04, podman is pinned at version 5.7.0. We have vulnerabilities reported related to golang paths inside podman. Upgrading podman to 6.0.2 remediates most of them. Building it from source is really giving us hard time as part of Dockerfile. Any plans to upgrade it to latest version as part of Ubuntu 26.04 package?

### Suggest potential solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

### Have you considered any alternatives?

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

### Additional context

Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.

comments.body: Not a team representative, but I suggest you to contact Ubuntu because they decide what to goes into their repositories. Podman team has no impact on what is distributed with each individual distro.

This has been discussed at length in various places before

https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/discussions/29200
https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/discussions/25582
https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/discussions/25219

and many more issues you find if you search here.
